question: Should OpenClaw add a model-facing parent-only sub-agent send contract, and should it be a dedicated sessions_send_parent tool or a reserved sessionKey:"parent" resolver?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape changes child-to-parent session authorization and model-facing tool semantics in a security-sensitive path.

options.title: Add a dedicated parent-only contract
options.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and forwarded targets.

options.title: Reserve sessionKey:"parent"
options.body: Keep sessions_send as the public tool but make parent a trusted resolver keyword rather than a literal caller-provided session key.

options.title: Decline native mid-run sends
options.body: Keep child-originated mid-run sends unsupported and document completion handoff, sessions_yield, and explicit trusted operator opt-ins as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Add a dedicated parent-only contract
recommendation.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and forwarded targets.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined signal from issue discussion and recent history across session tools, resolution, visibility, and sub-agent docs.
